description:
[EU MDR Annex VIII medical device 22 classification rules engine. Pure statutory logic, read-only, side-effect free]. Determines medical device risk class (Class I, Is, Im, Ir, IIa, IIb, III) under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 Annex VIII based on invasiveness, duration, active functions, and anatomical site, specifying Notified Body conformity assessment routes.
Usage: Pass device characteristics and intended purpose to obtain statutory classification, applicable Annexes, and PMS requirements.
Returns: JSON object with { deviceName: string, riskClass: string, governingRule: string, notifiedBodyInterventionMandatory: boolean, conformityAssessmentRoutes: array, postMarketSurveillanceRequirement: string, summaryRationale: string }.

absorbedByHumanBodyLocally.description: Rule 21: Whether device is composed of substances intended to be absorbed or dispersed

activeDeviceFunction.description: Functional category for active devices ex Rules 9-12

deviceName.description: Commercial or technical trade name of the medical device

durationOfUse.description: Duration of continuous use ex Annex VIII Section 1

hasMeasuringFunction.description: Whether device has a statutory measuring function (Class Im)

incorporatesMedicinalSubstanceAsAncillar.description: Rule 14: Whether device incorporates a substance which is a medicinal product if used separately

intendedPurpose.description: Clinical intended purpose as stated in instructions for use and labeling

invasiveness.description: Invasiveness category ex Annex VIII Section 1

isActiveDevice.description: Whether device relies on electrical energy or other power source

isReusableSurgicalInstrument.description: Whether device is a reusable surgical instrument (Class Ir)

isSterileWhenPlacedOnMarket.description: Whether device is delivered sterile (Class Is)

softwareInformsCriticalPatientManagement.description: Rule 11: Whether software decisions could cause death or irreversible deterioration

utilizesNanomaterials.description: Rule 19: Whether device consists of or incorporates nanomaterial with exposure potential

name: mdr_device_classification_engine
